# telnyx_agent_gateway_key (Resource)

A virtual key that applications call an Agent Gateway with, under its own models, budget and rate limits.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_agent_gateway_team" "support" {
  gateway_id          = telnyx_agent_gateway.example.id
  name                = "support"
  max_budget          = 100
  budget_resets_every = "30d"
}

resource "telnyx_agent_gateway_key" "support_bot" {
  gateway_id          = telnyx_agent_gateway.example.id
  name                = "support-bot"
  team_id             = telnyx_agent_gateway_team.support.id
  models              = ["gpt-4o-mini"]
  requests_per_minute = 60
}

# The key's value is only available after create.
output "support_bot_key" {
  value     = telnyx_agent_gateway_key.support_bot.key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) The gateway id.

### Optional

- `blocked` (Boolean) Whether the instance refuses the key.
- `budget_resets_every` (String) How often the key's spend resets, such as `30d`.
- `expires_in` (String) How long until the key stops working: a number and a unit, `s`, `m`, `h`, or `d`. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `max_budget` (Number) The most the key may spend, in USD, until its budget resets.
- `max_parallel_requests` (Number) The most requests the key may have in flight at once.
- `models` (Set of String) The models the key may use. Empty means every model the instance serves.
- `name` (String) A label for people; `null` when none was given.
- `requests_per_minute` (Number) The most requests the key may make per minute.
- `team_id` (String) The team the key belongs to, if any.
- `tokens_per_minute` (Number) The most tokens the key may use per minute.

### Read-Only

- `budget_resets_at` (String) When the key's spend next resets.
- `created_at` (String) When the key was issued.
- `expires_at` (String) When the key stops working; `null` when it does not expire.
- `id` (String) Identifies the key. It is a 64-character hash the instance stores in place of the key's value.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The key's value, sent to the gateway as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The API returns it only when the key is created, so it is kept in state and is null after import.
- `spend` (Number) What the key has spent since its budget last reset, in USD.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_agent_gateway_key.support_bot <gateway_id>/<id>
```
